text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Satori's staging demo next Thurs has a traffic spike. They asked for 3 temporary changes: (1) control-plane allowlist for staging, (2) rate-limit increase for demo keys, (3) route demo traffic to eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1. Can infra approve a 10-hour window?

sam_support: Do they want this on Hosted keys or Dedicated? Need IP ranges and RPS numbers.

maria_cs: Hosted. IPs and schedule below.
```
allowed_ips: [203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25]
rate_limit: 30 req/s -> 240 req/s (per-key aggregated)
regions: [eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1]
window: 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z to 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z
scope: staging/control-plane only
```

emma_se: Important: do not touch production routing. Keep change scoped to control-plane hostname for org org_00987. This demo is a renewal signal — they may request Dedicated after.

jake_infra: I can do ACL + temporary RL bump. Will need a change ticket, rollback plan, and logging tags to track cost. Prefer scoping to api.redwood-inference.com for their org id instead of whole VPC.

maria_cs: Agreed. Using hostname scope. Please create the change and loop in security. I'll paste a ready-to-use ticket body.

maria_cs: Ticket payload (paste into change tool):
```json
{
  "customer": "satori",
  "org_id": "org_00987",
  "scope": "control-plane hostname only",
  "allowed_ips": ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.128/25"],
  "rate_limit": {"from_rps": "30", "to_rps": "240"},
  "regions": ["eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"],
  "window_utc": {"start": "2026-03-25T16:00:00Z","end": "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z"},
  "rollback_plan": "auto-revert at end of window; manual rollback if errors > 1.5% or 95th latency > 600ms",
  "contact": "maria_cs@satori.com"
}
```

sam_support: Add logging tag and billing tag so CS can report cost impact. Also want synthetic checks from SG before demo.

jake_infra: Will add tag `satori-demo-2026-03-25`. Setting temporary alert: error-rate > 1.5% OR latency_95 > 600ms -> trigger rollback. Will stage change to 10% canary 30m before full rollout.

ops-bot: Change requests created: CS-4984 and INF-10012. Assigned to jake_infra. Pre-check scheduled 2026-03-25T15:20Z.

maria_cs: thx — ping here when pre-checks complete. I'll schedule an enablement walkthrough with Satori and share the runbook.

emma_se: Flagging Satori as "near-term renewal: high-touch" in CRM and noting SG latency root cause. I'll book a 30-min follow-up post-demo.

sam_support: Who owns the SG synthetic test at T-45? Need measurements: baseline tokens/s, 95th latency, error rate.

jake_infra: I'll run the probes from ap-southeast at T-45 and post the graphs.

ops-bot: INF-10012 -> change staged at 2026-03-25T15:22:03Z for canary validation.

jake_infra: Canary report: 10% traffic, 20m observation, no increased errors, 95th latency ~230ms in ap-southeast. Proceeding to full window at start time.

emma_se: Noted — capturing customer feedback point: "Demo fixed latency; consider Dedicated for production."

maria_cs: Demo completed successfully. Satori reported improved responsiveness and no incidents. Follow-up: post-mortem + renewal outreach. Thanks all :tada:
